facts.value: As an ASU student you’ll have exceptional opportunities to meet new people, travel to far away places, explore new subjects and discover all that learning has to offer.
You’ll be in or near the nation's fifth-largest city with some of the most beautiful weather you could ask for.
You can enjoy professional sporting events, arts and culture, and outdoor life, while taking advantage of the close proximity to major employers.
ASU and the Phoenix area really do have it all.
